subject: Staged commitment buckets & graceband terms for Polaris Health
messages:
From: Jason Liao <jason@polarishealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Polaris Health Procurement <procurement@polarishealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Committed spend structure - high level ask

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Polaris was impressed with the latency and cost profile you showed. We're starting to sketch a multi-year commitment vehicle and wanted to explore a staged drawdown approach rather than a single-year prepay. High-level asks from our side:

- Can you propose a staged bucket structure that handles a ramp from 40% to 100% utilization over 12 months?
- We need a small "graceband" to accommodate quarter-to-quarter variability (we typically see +/−12% swing).
- Pricing target: ~25% discount vs list at higher-than-commit tiers; open to tradeoffs (minimums, ramp incentives).

Can you share a template term sheet and an example ramp cadence? I'll loop in finance/procurement as needed (cc'd).

Attachment: (none)

Regards,
Jason Liao
Director of Platform Partnerships
Polaris Health

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Jason Liao <jason@polarishealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Committed spend structure - high level ask

Jason — thanks for the clear ask and for looping procurement in. Happy to propose a concrete staged drawdown that maps to Polaris's ramp profile. Quick clarifying questions before I build the term sheet:

- Is the 40% starting point an expected average in Q1 (or a guaranteed minimum)?
- When you say "25% at higher tiers" is that versus our standard hosted list price or a bespoke blended list you use internally?
- Do you prefer fixed monthly draws from a prepaid wallet or monthly reconciliation with true-up?

I'll draft a term sheet with: 3 staged buckets (initial ramp, mid ramp, steady-state), a 12-month cadence, a 10–15% graceband by default (we can size it to match your 12% target), and explicit overage/true-up language. Looping in Karthik to help with the usage math and Laura for the finance structure.

If helpful we can do a 30-minute call Wednesday to walk the draft.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@polarishealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jason Liao <jason@polarishealth.com>, Polaris Health Procurement <procurement@polarishealth.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Committed spend structure - high level ask

Vivek — thanks. Attaching our Q1–Q4 consumption forecast so you can align buckets to our expected seasonality. A few notes from finance/procurement:

- Polaris prefers a prepaid wallet with monthly drawdown (simpler for our capex planning).
- We can commit to a multi-year window (2–3 years) if the first-year ramp protections and discounts are clear.
- Graceband: 10–15% sounds reasonable; would like an automatic rollover for unused prepaid credit trimming (e.g., small rollover allowance) rather than immediate forfeiture.

Attachment: Polaris_Usage_Forecast_Q1-Q4.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet)

Regards,
Maria Gomez
Sr. Manager, Procurement
Polaris Health

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@polarishealth.com>, Jason Liao <jason@polarishealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed staged buckets, graceband, and rollover mechanics (term sheet attached)

Maria / Jason — thanks for the forecast, that helps a lot. I've attached a short term sheet and summarized the key points below. Please review and tell us where you'd like tighter/looser terms.

Attachment: Redwood_Staged_Drawdown_Termsheet_v2.pdf (PDF)

Summary (high level):
- Structure: 3 buckets across year 1 (Initial: months 1–3, Mid-ramp: months 4–7, Steady-state: months 8–12). Each bucket has a target drawdown percentage of the total first-year commit (40% / 30% / 30%).
- Price schedule: Tiered per-token pricing with step discounts at 60% and 90% of committed burn; top-tier discount at 26% vs list (meets your ~25% target).
- Graceband: +/-12% default band; overages within band are covered by the wallet (no penalty). Overages beyond band billed monthly at committed rate plus a 5% surcharge, with option to convert overage into next bucket credit if Polaris pre-approves in writing.
- Rollover: Up to 10% of unused wallet credit may roll to year 2; additional unused credit is eligible for a 6-month runway extension at 50% discount before expiry.
- Reconciliation: Monthly drawdown from prepaid wallet with quarterly true-up and a one-time annual audit right.
- Early termination / adjustment: 60-day notice for material changes; partial refunds pro-rated after year 1 subject to minimums.

Call to action: If this aligns, we'll hand the draft to legal (cc'd Neha) for redlines and to finance (cc'd Laura) to lock in the rounding/ASC treatment. I can also produce a consumption-mapped schedule using your forecast showing month-by-month wallet draw.

Thanks — happy to hop on a call to walk through.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@polarishealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jason Liao <jason@polarishealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed staged buckets, graceband, and rollover mechanics (term sheet attached)

Vivek / team — appreciate the clear summary and the draft term sheet. Polaris is generally aligned with the approach. A few final asks before we route to procurement sign-off: 

- Can you tighten the breach/overage notice to 30 days (vs 60) for our operational needs?
- We request automatic rollover for up to 12% (instead of 10%) to match our historical variance.
- Please add a short clause that allows a one-time mid-year bucket rebalance by mutual written agreement without penalty.

If you can send a v2 with those points, we can prepare an internal procurement packet and target a signature in early April.

Attachment: (none)

Thanks,
Maria Gomez
Sr. Manager, Procurement
Polaris Health
